capabilities.body: OpenAmer na shirya aiki, yana gudanar da shi da kayan aiki na gaske — terminal, burauza, fayiloli, lambar — kuma yana riƙe abin da ya yi aiki.
capabilities.title: Mai aiki da tunani tare

capabilities.body: Tattaunawa, ƙwaƙwalwa da samfura suna rayuwa a wannan na'ura. Ba a ɗora komai sai dai idan ka tambaya.
capabilities.title: Na'urarka, bayananka

capabilities.body: Harsuna 186, kowannensu a rubutun da kake karantawa. Farkon allo na app yana tambayar wane ne.
capabilities.title: Harsunanka daidai

capabilities.body: Kwarewa ana adanawa daga aikin kansa, don haka ayyuka na yau da kullum suna taƙaice yayin da kake amfani da shi.
capabilities.title: Kwarewa da ke girma

help: Tabbatar cewa wannan na'ura na iya isa intanet.
Gudanar da saitin sake — matakan da aka kammala ba a maimaita su ba.
Idan ya kasa sau biyu, buɗe log; layin ƙarshe suna nuni da mataki.
failure.lead: Babu canje-canje da aka mayar da su ba tare da sanarwa ba — OpenAmer yana dakatar inda ya tsaya, don haka gudu na biyu yana ci gaba daga nan.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer har yanzu yana kan sigar da ta gabata kuma yana ci gaba da aiki. Ba a raba wani abu ba.
failure.title: Saitin bai gama ba

language.lead: Saitin yana ci gaba a harshen da ka zaɓa nan. Za ka iya canza shi daga baya a app.
language.title: Zaɓi harshenka

progress.lead: Saitin ɗaya: OpenAmer yana sauke abin da yake buƙata kuma yana saita wannan na'ura. Bayan haka, kowane farawa yana tsallake dukkanin.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer yana maye gurbin sigar da ta gabata. Zama, ƙwaƙwalwa da saituna suna nan ba tare da canji ba.
progress.title: Saitin OpenAmer

stages.platform-sdks: Shigar da SDK na dandamali na sadarwa
stages.uv: Shigar da mai sarrafa fakitin uv

cards.body: Bude app ɗin ka kuma bayyana abin da kake son yi. OpenAmer yana aiki a bango kuma yana ba da rahoto.
cards.title: Fara da jimla

cards.body: Saituna → Nuna → Harshe. 186 yankuna, za a iya canza su a kowane lokaci.
cards.title: Zaɓi harshenka

cards.body: Aikin da ake maimaitawa yana zama kwarewa — a gaba zai ɗauki umarni guda.
cards.title: Bari ya tuna

success.errorTitle: Ba a iya kaddamar da app na tebur
success.lead: Duk abu yana cikin wuri. OpenAmer yanzu naka — a wannan na'ura, a harshenka.
success.title: OpenAmer ya shirya

bullets: Yana aiki a gida — tattaunawarka na nan a wannan na'ura
186 harsuna, ciki har da rubutun da kake karantawa
Duk wani abu na iya canzawa daga baya; babu wani abu da ya zama dindindin
welcome.lead: Mai aiki naka. A kan na'urarka. A harshenka.
welcome.leadUpdate: Sabon OpenAmer ya shirya. Wannan yana maye gurbin sigar da ta gabata kuma yana riƙe dukkan zama da saituna.
welcome.note: Yana ɗaukar mintuna kaɗan a haɗin yanar gizo na al'ada.
welcome.title: Barka da zuwa OpenAmer
